questions.q: In "Processes, sustainability and safety Apply", which of these is a key idea?
o: Peers ask three questions: does it compete with food, how far is the supply, what does it really save in emissions.
Vote, then explain why you changed or kept your view.
Sustainability: land use, water use, food competition, waste use, and indirect land-use change. Waste-based feedstocks usually have lower risk.
Groups are given the same region and asked to recommend one option.
